rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for motivating someone or recommending that something be done.

example.english: Companies should encourage employees to offer suggestions proactively.
example.traditional: 公司應該鼓勵員工主動提出意見。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jing1 goi1 gu2 lai6 jyun4 gung1 zyu2 dung6 tai4 ceot1 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when cheering someone on or giving them emotional support.

example.english: We’ll go to the venue to encourage you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jin6 coeng4 tung4 nei5 daa2 hei3

rows.note: Use this when encouraging the adoption or development of a policy, activity, or practice.

example.english: This new policy will encourage citizens to use public transport more.
example.traditional: 呢項新政策會推動市民多啲搭公共交通工具。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 san1 zing3 caak3 wui5 teoi1 dung6 si5 man4 do1 di1 daap3 gung1 gung6 gaau1 tung1 gung1 geoi6
